timestamp_derivation: After existing recovery was verified and the full failure-to-recovery sequence was demonstrated on a disposable PG16; before the author timestamp of the commit that introduced this receipt (21:53:24Z). Per T0091, in the order T0108 requires.

verified_first_unchanged.reconnect: Bounded exponential backoff with jitter, reset after a stable period. Retries are indefinite by design: a PMS returning overnight must be picked up unattended.
verified_first_unchanged.interrupted_sweep: A socket lost mid-roster publishes nothing and records no observation, so the last known-good mirror keeps serving guests and completeness can never be measured against half a building. Now asserted by TestAdapter_InterruptedSweepPublishesNothing.
verified_first_unchanged.recovery: A fresh DR and a whole new DS..DE, never a resumption of the fragment in flight. Now asserted by TestAdapter_RecoversWithAFreshSweepAfterInterruption.

added.connection_settings: backoff_min_ms, backoff_max_ms, stable_reset_seconds, link_down_alert_seconds, blocked_after_refusals -- audited, bounded, defaulted, read fresh on every reconnect cycle. The connector reads and cannot write them.
added.integration_blockers: LINK_DOWN, RECONCILIATION_BLOCKED and DEPARTURE_FOR_UNKNOWN_STAY, DERIVED from facts already recorded. No job, no writer, nothing to acknowledge; a blocker exists exactly as long as its condition does. Each states whether guests are affected, because a link alarm reads as an outage unless it says the mirror is still authorising people.

defect_fixed: pms_roster_reconcile used TEMP TABLE ... ON COMMIT DROP, which survives until the transaction commits rather than until the function returns, so a second call in one transaction failed outright. pmsd calls it once per transaction so production never saw it; the first controlled test to drive three generations in one block hit it immediately.
demonstration: Healthy (no blockers) -> link down 20 minutes (mirror untouched, LINK_DOWN visible, guests unaffected) -> three degraded sweeps naming 40 of 60 rooms (all REFUSED_ROSTER_INCOMPLETE, nothing closed, all 60 guests keep access, RECONCILIATION_BLOCKED naming the reason) -> full recovery (COMPLETED, 5 genuine departures closed automatically, blocker clears itself, building never shrank).
invariants_preserved: No departure is inferred from a vacant-room snapshot; the room inventory never shrinks because rooms leave the feed; no guest data is fabricated; post-snapshot arrivals and changes remain protected; the historical snapshot backlog stays resolved.
standing_exception: GO_UNKNOWN_STAY remains documented in docs/operations/STANDING_PMS_EXCEPTION_GO_UNKNOWN_STAY.md and is now also surfaced as the DEPARTURE_FOR_UNKNOWN_STAY blocker -- an external question, stated as one.
